candidates.title: De-prioritize sign-in to after adoption selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet choice and photo upload so users build affinity before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users before they even see pet options or customize their friend.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in post-engagement significantly reduces upfront churn on a 27.1% drop step.

candidates.title: Grid pet selection screen with live preview
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend screen with a responsive grid layout and interactive pet preview component.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion) and long median completion time (89s).

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the highest drop-off step (39.1% drop) with improved preview UX, but requires new UI.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick-Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive guidance screen right after home welcome teaching desktop pet controls and tray menu options.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received multiple complaints after onboarding regarding unclear pet controls and desktop visibility.

new_pet_controls_guide.headline: How to interact with your desktop pet
new_pet_controls_guide.body: Drag to move your pet around your desktop, or right-click to open controls and interaction options.

guard.reason: Adding a new screen after home_intro is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets post-onboarding confusion backed by support emails, but needs a new screen.

candidates.title: Instant pet preset selection flow
candidates.change: Add an instant pet choice screen preceding photo upload for users who want a ready-to-go pet without custom generation.
candidates.why: Custom photo pet generation takes long and generates support complaints when photo parsing fails.

new_quick_pet_select.headline: Instant Pet Adoption
new_quick_pet_select.body: Select from ready-to-adopt desktop pets instantly.

guard.reason: Adding a new sub-flow screen within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Bypasses high friction photo generation; strong evidence from both funnel drop and support complaints.

candidates.title: Account sync explanation on sign in
candidates.change: Add a clear security hint explaining how signing in preserves and restores pet data across installs.
candidates.why: Support theme shows 8 users reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in syncs your saved desktop pets safely to this account.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync explanation hint to sign_in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy/hint addition addressing specific support complaints about account reset confusion.

candidates.title: Desktop rendering progress & tips on wait screen
candidates.change: Add estimated time, tip carousel, and desktop placement info to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s (mean 2336s) causing user anxiety and drop-offs.

waiting.headline: Preparing your pet's arrival
waiting.body: Generating graphics and desktop pet assets...

components.text: Tip: If pet does not appear, check system tray icons.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information and progress tips is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Mitigates extreme wait times (201s median / 2336s mean) on the home wait screen.

candidates.title: Two-column path selection layout
candidates.change: Change choose_path screen layout to a two-column card structure with distinct visual options.
candidates.why: First step choose_path has a mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between choice paths.

choose_path.headline: How would you like to create your pet?
choose_path.body: Choose between customized generation or choosing a preset companion.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path screen layout while preserving both choices is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reduces high mean time on initial path selection screen via clearer visual cards.

candidates.title: Desktop notification prompt on onboarding finish
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts on home intro welcome.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing up on desktop or app not opening after finish.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to your new desktop companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is active on your screen. Right-click the system tray icon anytime to manage settings.

guard.reason: Adding notification option to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Fixes post-finish visibility issues noted in support emails.

candidates.title: Photo upload quality advice copy
candidates.change: Update upload_photos screen copy with photo framing hints and format recommendations.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights custom pet generation failures and visual glitches.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a clear photo of your pet
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit photos facing forward for best generation results.
upload_photos.hint: Supports JPG & PNG. Avoid blurry or dark photos.

guard.reason: Updating copy on upload_photos screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Cheap copy fix addressing photo upload failures on the highest drop-off step.

candidates.title: Centered sign-in redesign with account help notice
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in layout into a centered card with sync reassurance text.
candidates.why: 27.1% drop-off at sign_in plus 8 support complaints regarding account pet resets.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to save your pet
sign_in.body: Log in to link your pet to your account and preserve your progress.
sign_in.hint: Using an existing account? Your previous pets will automatically sync.

guard.reason: Redesigning sign_in screen layout is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Full sign-in redesign addressing sign-in drop-off and 8 support complaints.

picked: De-prioritize sign-in to after adoption selection
Grid pet selection screen with live preview
Desktop rendering progress & tips on wait screen
Desktop notification prompt on onboarding finish

decisions.title: De-prioritize sign-in to after adoption selection
Grid pet selection screen with live preview
Desktop notification prompt on onboarding finish
